nodes.label: Aissa persona (who speaks)
nodes.community_name: Docs : voix de marque et agents
nodes.rationale: The site speaks as Aissa herself, a warm, concrete, elegant, locally anchored founder, not an anonymous writer or institutional brand.

nodes.label: Anti-AI review checklist
nodes.community_name: Docs : voix de marque et agents

nodes.label: Business lexicon (preferred vocabulary, event universes)
nodes.community_name: Docs : voix de marque et agents

nodes.label: Local anchoring (Emerainville, 77, Ile-de-France)
nodes.community_name: Docs : voix de marque et agents
nodes.rationale: Local mentions give SEO value and authenticity but must be natural, not stuffed.

nodes.label: Reference paragraphs and recurring patterns
nodes.community_name: Docs : voix de marque et agents
nodes.rationale: Real published paragraphs are to be imitated exactly, with specific details, parenthetical asides, honest admissions and short closing sentences.

nodes.label: Editorial taboos (no prices, client names, competitors)
nodes.community_name: Docs : voix de marque et agents
nodes.norm_label: editorial taboos (no prices, client names, competitors)

nodes.label: Target audience and vouvoiement register
nodes.community_name: Docs : voix de marque et agents
nodes.rationale: Readers are engaged couples and event organizers seeking reassurance, concrete benchmarks, vision and personality; vouvoiement is always used.

nodes.label: Typographic style (no decorative em-dash, French guillemets)
nodes.community_name: Docs : voix de marque et agents
nodes.norm_label: typographic style (no decorative em-dash, french guillemets)
nodes.rationale: Rhythmic variance and no decorative em-dashes avoid the uniform rhythm that is a major AI marker.

nodes.label: Color palette (cream, plum, gold)
nodes.community_name: Docs : voix de marque et agents

nodes.label: Next.js agent rules (breaking changes, read bundled docs first)
nodes.community_name: Docs : voix de marque et agents
nodes.norm_label: next.js agent rules (breaking changes, read bundled docs first)
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking changes versus model training data, so agents must read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code and heed deprecation notices.

nodes.label: Banned LLM phrases and hallmark metaphors
nodes.community_name: Docs : voix de marque et agents
nodes.norm_label: banned llm phrases and hallmark metaphors
nodes.rationale: Stock LLM phrasing and cliche metaphors are excluded because they mark text as AI-written and clash with Aissa's concrete voice.

nodes.label: Art direction (premium, soft, floral)
nodes.community_name: Docs : voix de marque et agents
nodes.rationale: Design must feel custom-made, calm and luxurious, avoiding corporate, flashy, generic AI or heavy-shadow looks.

nodes.label: Sage accent (strict usage)
nodes.community_name: Docs : voix de marque et agents
nodes.rationale: Sage was added for a client request for green, reserved for nature/boheme/outdoor contexts so it complements the cream/plum/bordeaux/gold signature identity without diluting it.
